derivation: or (by permutation) שְׁרִיקָה; feminine passive participle of H8319 (שָׁרַק);
def: a whistling (in scorn); by analogy, a piping

occurrences.text: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
